links.outcome: Accuracy detecting normal versus abnormal EDX tests, multi-agent INSPIRE versus one-shot Base-LLM
links.effect: INSPIRE accuracy 92.2% vs Base-LLM 62.6% (p < 0.001); INSPIRE also higher AIGERS scores in finding, clinical diagnosis, semantic concordance (p < 0.001).
links.quote: INSPIRE achieved an accuracy of 92.2 % for detecting normal versus abnormal tests, significantly outperforming the Base-LLM model, which achieved 62.6 % (p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: multi-agent architecture with tool access to reference tables and textbook for EDX report generation

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel multi-agent LLM framework (INSPIRE) for interpreting nerve conduction studies and EMG against a baseline LLM on a test dataset.
